name: Fuudol v Ikita~i! ~Hadaka Apron Cabajou Mami~
original_name: ふぅどるvイキた～い！～裸エプロンキャバ嬢マミ～
source:
Koutaro came to a town on business where was famous for the entertainment district. He called a home delivery prostitute, Kaori, and he was mesmerized by her techniques. A few month later..., he visits the town again to meet Kaori but he can't find her there. Instead, he meets Mami, who works at a pub and falls in love with her. What will happen to him in the end...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090328193324/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1005185]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
幸太郎因公来到一座以娱乐街闻名的城市。他叫来了上门应召女郎香织，并被她的技巧彻底迷住。几个月后，他再次来到这座城市，想与香织见面，却怎么也找不到她。取而代之的是在酒吧工作的真美，而他也爱上了她。最终，幸太郎的命运将会如何……？

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090328193324/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1005185]Eroge Shop[/url]]
